CREATE TABLE "public"."erp_purchase_order_lines" (
  "billedQuantity" numeric DEFAULT '0'::numeric NOT NULL,
  "discountAmount" numeric NOT NULL,
  "discountPercent" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "grossAmount" numeric NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "lineNo" int4 NOT NULL,
  "lineTotal" numeric NOT NULL,
  "productId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "purchaseOrderId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "quantity" numeric NOT NULL,
  "receivedQuantity" numeric DEFAULT '0'::numeric NOT NULL,
  "requisitionLineId" uuid,
  "taxAmount" numeric NOT NULL,
  "taxPercent" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "unitPrice" numeric NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "erp_purchase_order_lines_billed_92f991e7" CHECK ("billedQuantity" >= 0 AND "billedQuantity" <= "receivedQuantity"),
  CONSTRAINT "erp_purchase_order_lines_percents_01abab9f" CHECK ("discountPercent" BETWEEN 0 AND 100 AND "taxPercent" BETWEEN 0 AND 100),
  CONSTRAINT "erp_purchase_order_lines_quantity_3b6690a7" CHECK ("quantity" > 0 AND "unitPrice" >= 0),
  CONSTRAINT "erp_purchase_order_lines_received_b8d29085" CHECK ("receivedQuantity" >= 0 AND "receivedQuantity" <= "quantity"),
  CONSTRAINT "erp_purchase_order_lines_total_ae91d4e0" CHECK ("lineTotal" = "grossAmount" - "discountAmount" + "taxAmount")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."erp_purchase_orders" (
  "approvedAt" timestamptz,
  "approvedBy" uuid,
  "closeReason" text,
  "closedAt" timestamptz,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "createdBy" uuid NOT NULL,
  "discountTotal" numeric NOT NULL,
  "expectedDate" text,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "idempotencyKey" text NOT NULL,
  "notes" text,
  "orderDate" text NOT NULL,
  "poNumber" text NOT NULL,
  "requisitionId" uuid,
  "rfqId" uuid,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'DRAFT' NOT NULL,
  "subtotal" numeric NOT NULL,
  "supplierId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "taxTotal" numeric NOT NULL,
  "totalAmount" numeric NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "erp_purchase_orders_status_5fd3317f" CHECK ("status" IN ('DRAFT', 'APPROVED', 'PARTIALLY_RECEIVED', 'RECEIVED', 'CLOSED', 'CANCELLED')),
  CONSTRAINT "erp_purchase_orders_total_afde76ef" CHECK ("totalAmount" = "subtotal" - "discountTotal" + "taxTotal")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."erp_purchase_receipt_lines" (
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "purchaseOrderLineId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "quantity" numeric NOT NULL,
  "receiptId" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "erp_purchase_receipt_lines_quantity_fc510296" CHECK ("quantity" > 0)
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."erp_purchase_receipts" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "createdBy" uuid NOT NULL,
  "deliveryNoteRef" text,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "idempotencyKey" text NOT NULL,
  "locationId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "notes" text,
  "purchaseOrderId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "qualityHold" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "receiptNumber" text NOT NULL,
  "receivedDate" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."erp_purchase_requisition_lines" (
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "lineNo" int4 NOT NULL,
  "notes" text,
  "plannedOrderId" uuid,
  "productId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "quantity" numeric NOT NULL,
  "requisitionId" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "erp_purchase_requisition_lines_quantity_fc510296" CHECK ("quantity" > 0)
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."erp_purchase_requisitions" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "createdBy" uuid NOT NULL,
  "decidedAt" timestamptz,
  "decidedBy" uuid,
  "decisionNote" text,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "idempotencyKey" text NOT NULL,
  "neededBy" text,
  "notes" text,
  "requisitionNumber" text NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'DRAFT' NOT NULL,
  "submittedAt" timestamptz,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "erp_purchase_requisitions_status_32a3dd2b" CHECK ("status" IN ('DRAFT', 'SUBMITTED', 'APPROVED', 'REJECTED', 'CANCELLED', 'ORDERED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."erp_rfq_lines" (
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "lineNo" int4 NOT NULL,
  "productId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "quantity" numeric NOT NULL,
  "rfqId" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "erp_rfq_lines_quantity_fc510296" CHECK ("quantity" > 0)
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."erp_rfq_quote_lines" (
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "quoteId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "rfqLineId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "unitPrice" numeric NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "erp_rfq_quote_lines_price_07e3086a" CHECK ("unitPrice" >= 0)
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."erp_rfq_quotes" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "createdBy" uuid NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "leadTimeDays" int4,
  "notes" text,
  "quoteRef" text,
  "rfqId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "supplierId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "taxPercent" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "totalAmount" numeric NOT NULL,
  "validUntil" text,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "erp_rfq_quotes_amounts_d58c0db4" CHECK ("taxPercent" BETWEEN 0 AND 100 AND "totalAmount" >= 0)
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."erp_rfqs" (
  "awardedQuoteId" uuid,
  "closedAt" timestamptz,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "createdBy" uuid NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "idempotencyKey" text NOT NULL,
  "notes" text,
  "requisitionId" uuid,
  "responseDue" text,
  "rfqNumber" text NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'OPEN' NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "erp_rfqs_status_4ba8b2ec" CHECK ("status" IN ('OPEN', 'AWARDED', 'CANCELLED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."erp_supplier_bill_lines" (
  "billId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "description" text NOT NULL,
  "discountAmount" numeric NOT NULL,
  "discountPercent" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "grossAmount" numeric NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "lineNo" int4 NOT NULL,
  "lineTotal" numeric NOT NULL,
  "productId" uuid,
  "purchaseOrderLineId" uuid,
  "quantity" numeric NOT NULL,
  "taxAmount" numeric NOT NULL,
  "taxPercent" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "unitPrice" numeric NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "erp_supplier_bill_lines_quantity_3b6690a7" CHECK ("quantity" > 0 AND "unitPrice" >= 0),
  CONSTRAINT "erp_supplier_bill_lines_total_ae91d4e0" CHECK ("lineTotal" = "grossAmount" - "discountAmount" + "taxAmount")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."erp_supplier_bills" (
  "approvedAt" timestamptz,
  "approvedBy" uuid,
  "billDate" text NOT NULL,
  "billNumber" text NOT NULL,
  "cancelReason" text,
  "cancelledAt" timestamptz,
  "cancelledBy" uuid,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "createdBy" uuid NOT NULL,
  "discountTotal" numeric NOT NULL,
  "dueDate" text NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "idempotencyKey" text NOT NULL,
  "notes" text,
  "purchaseOrderId" uuid,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'DRAFT' NOT NULL,
  "subtotal" numeric NOT NULL,
  "supplierId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "supplierInvoiceNumber" text NOT NULL,
  "taxTotal" numeric NOT NULL,
  "totalAmount" numeric NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "erp_supplier_bills_status_e344e5f8" CHECK ("status" IN ('DRAFT', 'APPROVED', 'CANCELLED')),
  CONSTRAINT "erp_supplier_bills_total_afde76ef" CHECK ("totalAmount" = "subtotal" - "discountTotal" + "taxTotal")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."erp_supplier_payments" (
  "amount" numeric NOT NULL,
  "billId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "createdBy" uuid NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "idempotencyKey" text NOT NULL,
  "method" text NOT NULL,
  "notes" text,
  "paymentDate" text NOT NULL,
  "paymentNumber" text NOT NULL,
  "reference" text,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'POSTED' NOT NULL,
  "supplierId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "voidReason" text,
  "voidedAt" timestamptz,
  "voidedBy" uuid,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "erp_supplier_payments_amount_ed0d10ac" CHECK ("amount" > 0),
  CONSTRAINT "erp_supplier_payments_method_582524af" CHECK ("method" IN ('CASH', 'BANK_TRANSFER', 'CHEQUE', 'CARD', 'OTHER')),
  CONSTRAINT "erp_supplier_payments_status_12d53be9" CHECK ("status" IN ('POSTED', 'VOIDED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."erp_suppliers" (
  "address" text,
  "code" text NOT NULL,
  "contactName" text,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "email" text,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "notes" text,
  "paymentTermsDays" int4 DEFAULT 30 NOT NULL,
  "phone" text,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'ACTIVE' NOT NULL,
  "taxRegistration" text,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "erp_suppliers_status_ee520df2" CHECK ("status" IN ('ACTIVE', 'INACTIVE')),
  CONSTRAINT "erp_suppliers_terms_301004b8" CHECK ("paymentTermsDays" BETWEEN 0 AND 365)
)
